verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a note-taking app, but the evidence pack contains nothing showing Reflect can be self-hosted. Reflect appears only as a vendor-hosted service: the API is served from reflect.app, and its notes are end-to-end encrypted on Reflect's own servers. Export to Markdown/HTML and the hosted API are adjacent openness features, not self-hosting of the core product, so they earn no credit.
